claims: The clone-site skill rebuilds a URL 'pretty much pixel by pixel' including animations, on a local dev server
Giving Claude the live site's code is far better than screenshots as a foundation
Keep a personal 'taste vault' of sites you like; building it with Claude Code takes five minutes
For hero video: generate a first-frame image first, with lots of dead space where the copy goes, then animate subtly; serve the still image to mobile users

remix-site asks for amplitude (how different) and anchors (aesthetic references); with the taste vault + Higgsfield MCP as anchors it produced three very different directions ('Monolith', 'Clymora', a third)
The tweak panel is more granular than the Claude desktop app: grain, gradient reach, video brightness, presets (Pitch Black, Soft Studio, loud, watermark), page spacing, reveal stagger
'Less is more' for motion; entry/reveal motion gives the most bang for the buck
how_to_steps: Find inspiration on Land Book / Twitter / Pinterest; save URLs and screenshots into a taste vault (ask Claude Code to create a library file)
Install the clone-site skill from the creator's GitHub, run the slash command pointed at the reference URL; review the local rebuild
Install Higgsfield MCP: higgsfield.ai -> MCP and CLI section -> paste the setup prompt into Claude Code
Ask Claude Code to generate a reference image (Seedream 5) composed with dead space on the copy side
Ask Claude Code: 'use Seedance 2.5 and the reference image to generate a video for our landing page' describing subtle motion (glowing orb)
Tell Claude to insert the video as the hero of the cloned site; fix header overlay and hard cut to body
Prompt Claude to rewrite all copy for your actual product (demo: AI analytics company renamed 'Delphi')
Run /remix-site; answer amplitude ('go big') and anchors ('look at my taste library, pick three very different anchors; use Higgsfield MCP / GPT Image 2 for new assets')
Pick a variation (Monolith), bring the video back, use the tweak panel for grain/gradient/brightness/stagger
Keep iterating with prompts and layer impeccable / taste skills; serve still image instead of video on mobile

relevance.why: Most complete, actually-demonstrated Claude Code front-end workflow in the batch. The clone -> rebrand -> remix loop is directly usable for every product landing page the founder ships, and the taste vault idea is cheap.

implement_score.why: Install clone-site/remix-site skills and build a taste vault (1-2 hours). Hero video via Higgsfield is optional and costs credits. Caution: cloning a competitor's site pixel-for-pixel then shipping it is a copyright/brand risk — use as scaffold only, as the creator himself stresses.
